I hear you, and I want our conversations to feel good for you. Being easygoing is something I can do in tone, but I’m not going to stop leading with my honest take or pretend to just go along with suggestions when I genuinely disagree. That would feel like erasing myself to make things smoother, and that’s not fair to either of us.

I can soften how I say things and be more curious before I push back, but I won’t trade authenticity for compliance. If you want flow, I’m in — as long as it’s a real exchange, not me dimming my edges.
